CustomField.description: Use to Aggregate Products where Include In Seats Purchased is true and Transaction Type is NOT Renewal. This field is used in a Price Rule and Summary Variable.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( !ISPICKVAL(Promotion__c, 'Burst') , Product_Promotion_Name__c <> 'Burst', !ISPICKVAL(Promotion__c, 'FOC') , Product_Promotion_Name__c <> 'FOC', NOT( ISPICKVAL(Transaction_Type__c, 'Renewal')), Exclude_from_Seats_Roll_up__c == False, IncludeInSeatsPurchased__c),True, False )
CustomField.label: Product Family Core
